mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 50% of the time, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If unemployment rises above 10% but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When employment increases but unemployment also rises, it may indicate a complex labor market, leading to uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If both employment increases and unemployment rises but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production grows but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates easy monetary policy, boosting equity markets and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If federal funds rate is low but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts indicates weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts fall below 500 but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate alongside falling retail sales indicates tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If federal funds rise and retail sales fall but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate indicates tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If federal funds rate is high but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is falsified.
